scenes.title: Evening Window
scenes.narration: The hills grow deep within the window. A breeze arrives, and one leaf drifts.
scenes.sourceQuote: The hills grow deep within the window. A breeze arrives, and one leaf drifts.

scenes.title: Night Road
scenes.narration: Lamplight shows the long road home. The moon walks bright beside the traveler.
